# 💯 Requirements

## [🔬coda📚py💻coda🔖imports](composerepo://p/r/coda/b/l/py/f/coda.py/s/Imports)

Imports MUST include standard library, third-party FastMCP with Context, and module-level configuration.

## [🔬coda📚py💻coda🔖helpers](composerepo://p/r/coda/b/l/py/f/coda.py/s/Helpers)

Helpers MUST provide private functions for config loading and project root resolution.

## [🔬coda📚py💻coda🔖session](composerepo://p/r/coda/b/l/py/f/coda.py/s/Session)

Session MUST hold mutable state for the current project, run, iteration, and target. Shared by both MCP and sidecar modes.

## [🔬coda📚py💻coda🔖resources](composerepo://p/r/coda/b/l/py/f/coda.py/s/Resources)

Resources MUST expose MCP resource handlers for measures, targets, properties, rules, platforms, breachs, translations, and project data.

## [🔬coda📚py💻coda🔖tools](composerepo://p/r/coda/b/l/py/f/coda.py/s/Tools)

Tools MUST expose stateful MCP tool handlers: start_working_on_project, start_run, start_iteration, start_translation, get_status, translate, save_translation, validate, save_report, fix.

## [🔬coda📚py💻coda🔖prompts](composerepo://p/r/coda/b/l/py/f/coda.py/s/Prompts)

Prompts MUST expose MCP prompt handlers for design change instructions.

## [🔬coda📚py💻coda🔖sidecar](composerepo://p/r/coda/b/l/py/f/coda.py/s/Sidecar)

Sidecar MUST implement a JSON-over-stdio protocol for Electron integration with request ID correlation and heartbeat support.

## [🔬coda📚py💻coda🔖main](composerepo://p/r/coda/b/l/py/f/coda.py/s/Main)

Main MUST provide the CLI entry point supporting --sidecar (JSON-over-stdio), --mcp-stdio (MCP stdio), and default (MCP streamable-http) modes.
